whoItsFor: Developers and teams who need an AI agent to automate real web browsing, such as scraping or checking prices, on sites that block standard automated browsers with anti-bot checks or captchas. It can run from an MCP-compatible assistant or a standalone web UI.
useCases: Checking fares or prices across several dates on travel sites by clicking through calendar widgets
Browsing sites that block other AI browser agents with captchas or anti-bot checks
Reading and comparing page content where a person's judgement is needed, rather than calling an API
